title: Activation of accessibility features
condition: Documented accessibility features exist

title: Biometrics
condition: A biological characteristic is used for identification or control

title: Preservation of accessibility information during conversion
condition: Information or communication is converted

title: Locking or toggle controls: status
condition: A locking or toggle control exists

title: Key repeat
condition: A keyboard or keypad with a key repeat function that cannot be turned off enters repeated data into fields or documents

title: Double-strike key acceptance
condition: A keyboard interface service or keyboard is included and the time before the same key is accepted again can be adjusted

title: Simultaneous user actions
condition: A mode of operation requires simultaneous user actions

title: Real-time bidirectional voice, real-time text and video communication
condition: Two-way voice communication is provided

title: Caption or subtitle processing
condition: Video with synchronized audio is displayed or converted

title: Audio description processing
condition: Video with synchronized audio is displayed or converted

title: User control of captions or subtitles and audio description
condition: A surface primarily displays video with synchronized audio (V4.1.1: and controls the activation of subtitles, audio description and spoken subtitles)

title: WCAG conformance requirements
condition: Web page

title: User preferences
condition: Web page; unconditional in V3.2.1 Table A.1

title: Non-web documents
condition: V3.2.1 Table A.1: documents and forms downloadable from a web page. V4.1.1 Table A.2: the ICT is or includes a non-web document

title: Authoring tools: content technology
condition: Authoring tool functionality exists

title: Authoring tools: accessible content creation
condition: Authoring tool functionality exists

title: Authoring tools: preservation of accessibility information in transformations
condition: Restructuring or re-coding transformations are provided

title: Authoring tools: repair assistance
condition: The tool can detect that content fails a requirement

title: Authoring tools: templates
condition: Templates are provided

title: Accessibility and compatibility features are documented
condition: Product documentation exists; unconditional in V3.2.1 Table A.1

title: Accessible documentation and information about products and services
condition: Documentation or information is provided in digital form; unconditional in V3.2.1 Table A.1

title: Support services: accessibility information and accessible communication
condition: Support services are offered; unconditional in V3.2.1 Table A.1

title: One mode
condition: Conformance is achieved through an alternative mode of operation

title: Caller ID
condition: Caller identification or other identification functions are provided

title: Alternatives to voice-based services
condition: Voice mail, auto-attendant or interactive voice response facilities are provided

title: Parsing (WCAG 2.1 SC 4.1.1)
condition: Web page; V3.2.1 only

title: Usage without vision
condition: Visual modes of operation are provided

title: Usage with limited vision
condition: Visual modes of operation are provided

title: Usage without perception of colour
condition: Visual modes of operation are provided

title: Usage without hearing
condition: Auditory modes of operation are provided

title: Usage with limited hearing
condition: Auditory modes of operation are provided

title: Usage with no or limited vocal capability
condition: Vocal input is required

title: Usage with limited manipulation or strength
condition: Manual actions are required

title: Usage with limited reach
condition: The ICT is stationary, free-standing or installed

title: Minimize photosensitive seizure triggers
condition: Visual modes of operation are provided

title: Usage with limited cognition, language or learning
condition: Information is provided or user interaction is required

title: Privacy
condition: Features for accessibility are provided

title: Requirements that depend on the type of ICT: closed functionality, hardware, non-web software, electronic programme guides, relay and emergency services
condition: The product is or includes such ICT

title: Information on how the service meets accessibility requirements (Article 13(2) and Annex V)
condition: Service within the scope of Directive (EU) 2019/882

title: Information about the functioning of the service and about the accessibility characteristics of products used to provide it (Annex I Section III(b))
condition: Service within the scope of Directive (EU) 2019/882

title: Support services provide accessibility information in accessible modes of communication (Annex I Section III(d))
condition: Support services are available

title: Accessibility information of the products and services being sold (Annex I Section IV(g)(i))
condition: The responsible economic operator provides that information

title: Identification, security and payment functionality, when delivered as part of a service instead of a product, is perceivable, operable, understandable and robust (Annex I Section IV(g)(ii))
condition: E-commerce service provided to consumers

title: Identification methods, electronic signatures and payment services are perceivable, operable, understandable and robust (Annex I Section IV(g)(iii))
condition: E-commerce service provided to consumers
surfaceFamily: Sign-in methods/acceptance and signature steps/payment providers

title: Procedures keep the service in conformity when the service or the standards change (Article 13(3))
condition: Service within the scope of Directive (EU) 2019/882

title: Non-conformities are corrected and reported and conformity can be demonstrated on request (Article 13(4) and 13(5))
condition: Service within the scope of Directive (EU) 2019/882

title: Accessibility of the products used in the provision of the service (Annex I Section III(a))
condition: Products within the scope of the Directive are used to provide the service
surfaceFamily: Terminals and devices a deployer operates

title: Accessibility statement with a feedback mechanism and a link to the enforcement procedure (Article 7(1))
condition: Public sector body within the scope of Directive (EU) 2016/2102
